paragraphs.text: I exhort therefore, first of all, that supplications, prayers, intercessions, thanksgivings, be made for all men;
paragraphs.original: Παρακαλῶ οὖν πρῶτον πάντων ποιεῖσθαι δεήσεις, προσευχάς, ἐντεύξεις, εὐχαριστίας, ὑπὲρ πάντων ἀνθρώπων,
paragraphs.translit: Parakalō oun prōton pantōn poieisthai deēseis, proseuchas, enteuxeis, eucharistias, hyper pantōn anthrōpōn,

paragraphs.text: for kings and all that are in high place; that we may lead a tranquil and quiet life in all godliness and gravity.
paragraphs.original: ὑπὲρ βασιλέων καὶ πάντων τῶν ἐν ὑπεροχῇ ὄντων, ἵνα ἤρεμον καὶ ἡσύχιον βίον διάγωμεν ἐν πάσῃ εὐσεβείᾳ καὶ σεμνότητι.
paragraphs.translit: hyper basileōn kai pantōn tōn en hyperochē ontōn, hina ēremon kai hēsychion bion diagōmen en pasē eusebeia kai semnotēti.

paragraphs.text: This is good and acceptable in the sight of God our Saviour;
paragraphs.original: τοῦτο καλὸν καὶ ἀπόδεκτον ἐνώπιον τοῦ σωτῆρος ἡμῶν θεοῦ,
paragraphs.translit: touto kalon kai apodekton enōpion tou sōtēros hēmōn theou,

paragraphs.text: who would have all men to be saved, and come to the knowledge of the truth.
paragraphs.original: ὃς πάντας ἀνθρώπους θέλει σωθῆναι καὶ εἰς ἐπίγνωσιν ἀληθείας ἐλθεῖν.
paragraphs.translit: hos pantas anthrōpous thelei sōthēnai kai eis epignōsin alētheias elthein.

paragraphs.text: For there is one God, one mediator also between God and men, [himself] man, Christ Jesus,
paragraphs.original: εἷς γὰρ θεός, εἷς καὶ μεσίτης θεοῦ καὶ ἀνθρώπων ἄνθρωπος Χριστὸς Ἰησοῦς,
paragraphs.translit: heis gar theos, heis kai mesitēs theou kai anthrōpōn anthrōpos Christos Iēsous,

paragraphs.text: who gave himself a ransom for all; the testimony [to be borne] in its own times;
paragraphs.original: ὁ δοὺς ἑαυτὸν ἀντίλυτρον ὑπὲρ πάντων, τὸ μαρτύριον καιροῖς ἰδίοις·
paragraphs.translit: ho dous heauton antilytron hyper pantōn, to martyrion kairois idiois·

paragraphs.text: whereunto I was appointed a preacher and an apostle (I speak the truth, I lie not), a teacher of the Gentiles in faith and truth.
paragraphs.original: εἰς ὃ ἐτέθην ἐγὼ κῆρυξ καὶ ἀπόστολος— ἀλήθειαν λέγω, οὐ ψεύδομαι— διδάσκαλος ἐθνῶν ἐν πίστει καὶ ἀληθείᾳ.
paragraphs.translit: eis ho etethēn egō kēryx kai apostolos— alētheian legō, ou pseudomai— didaskalos ethnōn en pistei kai alētheia.

paragraphs.text: I desire therefore that the men pray in every place, lifting up holy hands, without wrath and disputing.
paragraphs.original: Βούλομαι οὖν προσεύχεσθαι τοὺς ἄνδρας ἐν παντὶ τόπῳ, ἐπαίροντας ὁσίους χεῖρας χωρὶς ὀργῆς καὶ διαλογισμοῦ.
paragraphs.translit: Boulomai oun proseuchesthai tous andras en panti topō, epairontas hosious cheiras chōris orgēs kai dialogismou.

paragraphs.text: In like manner, that women adorn themselves in modest apparel, with shamefastness and sobriety; not with braided hair, and gold or pearls or costly raiment;
paragraphs.original: ὡσαύτως καὶ γυναῖκας ἐν καταστολῇ κοσμίῳ μετὰ αἰδοῦς καὶ σωφροσύνης κοσμεῖν ἑαυτάς, μὴ ἐν πλέγμασιν καὶ χρυσίῳ ἢ μαργαρίταις ἢ ἱματισμῷ πολυτελεῖ,
paragraphs.translit: hōsautōs kai gynaikas en katastolē kosmiō meta aidous kai sōphrosynēs kosmein heautas, mē en plegmasin kai chrysiō ē margaritais ē himatismō polytelei,

paragraphs.text: but (which becometh women professing godliness) through good works.
paragraphs.original: ἀλλʼ ὃ πρέπει γυναιξὶν ἐπαγγελλομέναις θεοσέβειαν, διʼ ἔργων ἀγαθῶν.
paragraphs.translit: allʼ ho prepei gynaixin epangellomenais theosebeian, diʼ ergōn agathōn.

paragraphs.text: Let a woman learn in quietness with all subjection.
paragraphs.original: γυνὴ ἐν ἡσυχίᾳ μανθανέτω ἐν πάσῃ ὑποταγῇ·
paragraphs.translit: gynē en hēsychia manthanetō en pasē hypotagē·

paragraphs.text: But I permit not a woman to teach, nor to have dominion over a man, but to be in quietness.
paragraphs.original: διδάσκειν δὲ γυναικὶ οὐκ ἐπιτρέπω, οὐδὲ αὐθεντεῖν ἀνδρός, ἀλλʼ εἶναι ἐν ἡσυχίᾳ.
paragraphs.translit: didaskein de gynaiki ouk epitrepō, oude authentein andros, allʼ einai en hēsychia.

paragraphs.text: For Adam was first formed, then Eve;
paragraphs.original: Ἀδὰμ γὰρ πρῶτος ἐπλάσθη, εἶτα Εὕα·
paragraphs.translit: Adam gar prōtos eplasthē, eita Heua·

paragraphs.text: and Adam was not beguiled, but the woman being beguiled hath fallen into transgression:
paragraphs.original: καὶ Ἀδὰμ οὐκ ἠπατήθη, ἡ δὲ γυνὴ ἐξαπατηθεῖσα ἐν παραβάσει γέγονεν.
paragraphs.translit: kai Adam ouk ēpatēthē, hē de gynē exapatētheisa en parabasei gegonen.

paragraphs.text: but she shall be saved through her child-bearing, if they continue in faith and love and sanctification with sobriety.
paragraphs.original: σωθήσεται δὲ διὰ τῆς τεκνογονίας, ἐὰν μείνωσιν ἐν πίστει καὶ ἀγάπῃ καὶ ἁγιασμῷ μετὰ σωφροσύνης.
paragraphs.translit: sōthēsetai de dia tēs teknogonias, ean meinōsin en pistei kai agapē kai hagiasmō meta sōphrosynēs.
